title: Reparations
description: After breaking a cardinal rule of the Thieves Guild, you must speak to Vex in the Ragged Flagon and pay 1,000 gold in reparations to regain your membership.

base_facts: Vex is a senior member of the Thieves Guild who operates out of the Ragged Flagon.
Vex handles disciplinary matters within the guild, including reparation payments.

BANNED_FROM_GUILD: A guild member has broken the cardinal rules and been expelled. They need to pay reparations to rejoin.
SPEAK_TO_VEX: This member owes 1,000 gold in reparations before they can be reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
REPARATIONS_PAID: The former guild member has paid their reparations and been reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
Player has paid 1,000 gold in reparations and been reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
Talk to Vex and pay 1,000 gold.
To rejoin the guild, speak to Vex in The Ragged Flagon , who will reprimand you and demand 1,000 gold as reparations.

beats.comment: Player has been banned from the Thieves Guild for breaking a cardinal rule such as assaulting a member or stealing from the guild.
Player speaks to Vex about making reparations after being banned from the guild.
Player needs to bring 1,000 gold to Vex as reparations for rejoining the guild.
Player has paid 1,000 gold in reparations and been reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
